content: पाञ्चाल {%a.%} (-ली|{%f.%}) Belonging to or ruling over the Pañchālas. .{@-लः@} .²1 The country of the Pañchālas. .²2 A prince of the Pañchālas. .{@-लाः@} {%m.%} (<ab>pl.</ab>) .²1 The people of the Pañchālas. .²2 An association of five guilds ({%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} of a carpenter, weaver, barber, washerman, and shoe-maker).

पाञ्चाली .²1 A woman or princess of the Pañchālas. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Draupadī, the wife of the Pāṇḍavas. .²3 A doll, puppet. .²4 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) One of the four styles of composition. The <ls>S. D.</ls> thus defines it:-- वर्णैः शेषैः ({%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} माधुर्यव्यञ्जकौजःप्रकाशकाभ्यां भिन्नैः) पुनर्द्वयोः समस्तपञ्चषपदो बन्धः पाञ्चालिको मतः .. <ls n="S. D.">628</ls>.
